column1: # bench/origin corpus — 16 of the 33 crates already cloned under
# realval/corpus_src/src/ (reused per plan; see corpus.lock for exact pins).
# columns: name  repo_dir  bin_name  strata  n_path_deps
#   repo_dir  — relative to realval/corpus_src/src/, also the cargo manifest
#               root (all 16 have Cargo.toml directly at repo_dir/Cargo.toml)
#   bin_name  — the actual built executable name (several differ from the
#   strata    — async | generics | workspace | depfree, comma-separated,
#               a crate can carry more than one tag
#   n_path_deps — count of `path = "..."` deps in the crate's own manifests,
#               recorded at selection time (see selection rationale below)
# Selection rationale (meets every §1 criterion: produces an executable,
# >=3 transitive deps, builds clean on stable, picked for variety):
#   async/tokio (>=3 required, 5 picked)  : oha, xh, miniserve, dufs, procs
#   heavy generics (>=2 required, 4 picked): starship, typos, taplo, tokei
#   workspace + path-deps (>=2 required, 3 picked): ripgrep, trippy, just
#   nearly dep-free (>=2 required, 4 picked): hexyl, xsv, zoxide, pastel
# Pilot subset (4-crate dry run before the full 16): hexyl, ripgrep, oha,
# starship — smallest/largest package count, sync/async, workspace/flat.
